verdicts.reason: A keeps a coherent centred stack and readable hierarchy, but the headline leaves 'last' orphaned on its own line, the legal line is moved above an oversized CTA that competes with the headline, and the sale banner is pushed against the top-left edge. B leaves a large dead area beside the bottle, which sits awkwardly left of centre. Its bottom row crams the subcopy into a narrow wrapped column and the legal text into a tiny 7-line sliver either side of the CTA, all pressed toward the bottom edge, which breaks the reading order and makes the fine print hard to read.
